// Negative link-proof fixture: runtime.KeepAlive does not root all executable
// API bodies through native linker garbage collection. Never flash this image.
package main

import (
	"runtime"
	"github.com/hilli/esp32c6-radio/settings"
)

var paths=[...]any{
	settings.Open,settings.FormatEmpty,settings.OpenSharedV2,settings.FormatEmptySharedV2,
	(*settings.SharedV2).Close,(*settings.SharedV2).ThreadSettings,(*settings.SharedV2).MatterBlobs,
	(*settings.SharedThreadSettings).Get,(*settings.SharedThreadSettings).Set,
	(*settings.SharedThreadSettings).Add,(*settings.SharedThreadSettings).Delete,(*settings.SharedThreadSettings).Wipe,
	(*settings.SharedMatterBlobs).Get,(*settings.SharedMatterBlobs).Set,
	(*settings.SharedMatterBlobs).Delete,(*settings.SharedMatterBlobs).Keys,(*settings.SharedMatterBlobs).Close,
}

func main() {
	println("NEGATIVE LINK ONLY; physical NOT_RUN")
	runtime.KeepAlive(paths)
	select {}
}
